title: Tiered Formal and Numerical Methods for T-Duality and Frontier String Dynamics on K3 × T²: Closing the Loop via LeanFlow Stiff Solvers with Native Duality, Topological Data Analysis, and Lean 4 Checking
description: Corrected version of the manuscript 'Tiered Formal and Numerical Methods for T-Duality and Frontier String Dynamics on K3 × T²: Closing the Loop via LeanFlow Stiff Solvers with Native Duality, Topological Data Analysis, and Lean 4 Checking' and its reproducible artifacts. This version withdraws claims made in the version issued as Zenodo record 22683565 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22683565); see the Correction notice in the manuscript. The repository couples numerical integration (SciPy Radau and solve_bvp solvers; custom explicit Rust integrators) with Lean 4 checking of discrete algebraic invariants and topological data analysis (TDA Mapper) of simulation output. Status of the contents, by evidence tier: (1) Kernel-checked foundation: integer O(d,d;Z) T-duality charge action and the generalized metric at B = 0, K3/Mukai/K3×T² lattice signatures, flux-tadpole arithmetic and Mathieu-moonshine dimension facts are kernel-checked in the external LeanMaster project (release v2.2.0) and restated in lean_foundation/, depending only on Lean's three standard axioms. They do not cover the field-level Buscher rules for metric, B-field and dilaton. (2) Local Lean files in proofs/ are superseded and are not a verification of the physics they name: BuscherRules.lean rests on five global axioms, one of which (inv_inv) proves False when instantiated at Nat, and many other theorems hold by construction of their definitions. (3) All simulation outputs (moduli geodesics, Kummer-orbifold Langevin dynamics, flat-space Coleman bounce, tachyon condensation, TDA Mapper graphs) are exploratory numerics and will be regenerated after numerics fixes. (4) No benchmark or cost figure is claimed: all speed and cost comparisons are pending hardware verification. The external rusty-SUNDIALS integrator is planned but is not present in this repository and was not used.
notes: Artifact bundle includes: (1) compiled manuscript T_duality_Alone.pdf and its LaTeX source T_duality_Alone.tex; (2) local Lean 4 files in proofs/ (superseded; see the manuscript's Correction notice for what they do and do not establish) and the lean_foundation/ project restating kernel-checked LeanMaster theorems; (3) Rust simulator crate rust_simulator/ and Python driver workshopcosmo.py; (4) simulation telemetry summaries (tda_mapper_skeleton.json, kummer_langevin_summary.json, vacuum_decay_cdl_summary.json, tachyon_condensation_summary.json). Telemetry values are exploratory, some committed summaries disagree with each other, and the TDA Mapper output is not seeded; values will be regenerated.
